svg.title: Existing published Au MoS2 PDOS contours, Figure3 panelsg andh
svg.desc: Unchanged pixels from published Figure3: pristine(g), lateral barrier0.15eV; near-edge defect(h),0.68eV. Existing black band-edge guides and original LDOS color scale are retained. The0.68eV text is the rounded midpoint; the summary preserves0.675±0.025eV.
